declarations.name: Accordion
declarations.description: Stacks accordion items. With single, opening one closes the rest.

declarations.name: AccordionItem
declarations.description: One section that opens and closes. The summary slot is the always-visible header.

declarations.name: Avatar
declarations.description: A round picture of a person. With no image, the first letter of the name stands in.

declarations.name: AvatarGroup
declarations.description: Overlapping avatars. Past the max, the rest fold into a count.

declarations.name: Badge
declarations.description: A short status label. Solid and bright, never murky.

declarations.name: Banner
declarations.description: A message across the top of a section: info, success, warning, or danger.

declarations.name: Box
declarations.description: The general box. Picks its direction from an attribute. Row is the default.

declarations.name: Breadcrumb
declarations.description: One step in a trail. The last step is the current page: it isn't a link and has no caret after it.

declarations.name: Breadcrumbs
declarations.description: A trail of breadcrumbs. The last one is always the current page.

declarations.name: Button
declarations.description: Runs an action. Pills act. Shrinks and darkens on press.

declarations.name: Calendar
declarations.description: One month of days. The chosen day's fill slides, like every selection in fem. Arrow keys move by day and week, Page Up and Page Down by month.

attributes.name: start
attributes.description: Range mode reads and writes start and end.

members.name: start
members.description: Range mode reads and writes start and end.

declarations.name: Card
declarations.description: A raised surface that groups related content. It is a column, so its children stack with the gap.

declarations.name: Checkbox
declarations.description: Turns one option on or off. Works in forms like a native checkbox.

declarations.name: CheckboxGroup
declarations.description: Groups checkboxes under one name and label. Each checked box sends its own value with the form, like native checkboxes that share a name.

declarations.name: Chip
declarations.description: A choice you toggle, like a filter. A chosen chip inverts.

declarations.name: Column
declarations.description: A box that is always a column.

declarations.name: Combobox
declarations.description: A select you can type into. Typing filters the options. Arrow keys move, Enter picks, Escape closes and puts the chosen label back.

declarations.name: DatePicker
declarations.description: A box like select that opens a calendar. The value is an ISO date, like 2026-10-21. The panel opens in the inverse theme, like every floating panel.

declarations.name: DateRangePicker
declarations.description: A box like select that opens a range calendar. Pick a start day, then an end day. Submits "start,end".

declarations.name: Dialog
declarations.description: A centered panel that asks for a decision. Blocks the page until it closes.

declarations.name: Divider
declarations.description: A divider is a filled bar on the surface scale, not a border. Use it between groups, never around them.

declarations.name: EmptyState
declarations.description: What a screen shows when there's nothing in it yet: an icon, a heading that names what's missing, one line on how to add it, and the action that does.

declarations.name: Field
declarations.description: Owns the label, help, and error for one control, so every control in the system is labeled the same way. Stacked puts the label above. Inline puts it on the left with the control on the right.

declarations.name: Grid
declarations.description: A grid of equal columns, by count or by minimum column width.

declarations.name: Heading
declarations.description: A title on the type scale. Level sets meaning and a natural size.

declarations.name: Icon
declarations.description: A Phosphor icon. Takes the text color around it.

declarations.name: Input
declarations.description: A single line of text. Works in forms like a native input.

declarations.name: Menu
declarations.description: A list of actions that opens from a trigger, in the inverse theme.

declarations.name: MenuItem
declarations.description: One action in a fem-menu.

declarations.name: Nav
declarations.description: A vertical list of destinations, like a sidebar. The selected fill slides between items.

declarations.name: NavItem
declarations.description: One destination in a fem-nav: an icon, a label, and an optional end slot for a count or badge.

attributes.name: collapsed
attributes.description: Set by fem-nav. Shows the icon only.

members.name: collapsed
members.description: Set by fem-nav. Shows the icon only.

declarations.name: Option
declarations.description: One choice in a fem-select or fem-combobox.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Set by a combobox while the arrow keys rest on this option, since focus stays in its input.

members.name: active
members.description: Set by a combobox while the arrow keys rest on this option, since focus stays in its input.

declarations.name: Pagination
declarations.description: Page numbers for long lists. The current page's fill slides, like every other selection in fem.

declarations.name: Popover
declarations.description: A floating panel for any content: a short form, a color picker, details. Like menus, it opens in the inverse theme, so it stands off the page with no shadow. Every fem component inside flips with it.

declarations.name: Progress
declarations.description: Shows how far along a task is.

declarations.name: Radio
declarations.description: Picks one option from a set. Group radios with fem-radio-group.

declarations.name: RadioGroup
declarations.description: Owns a set of radios: their shared name, which one is checked, and arrow key movement. The list kind turns each radio into a row with a sliding fill.

declarations.name: RangeSlider
declarations.description: Two thumbs on one track, for a span like a BPM range. Each thumb is a real range input, so touch, drag, and the keyboard all work natively. The thumbs can't cross.

declarations.name: Row
declarations.description: A box that is always a row. Reads better in markup.

declarations.name: Segment
declarations.description: One choice in a fem-segmented control.

declarations.name: Segmented
declarations.description: A few choices side by side. The selected fill slides.

declarations.name: Select
declarations.description: Picks one option from a list that opens below. Works in forms.

declarations.name: Sheet
declarations.description: A panel that slides in from the bottom or side.

declarations.name: Skeleton
declarations.description: A flat placeholder that pulses while content loads. No shimmer gradient: fem stays flat.

declarations.name: Slider
declarations.description: Picks a number along a track. Add show-value for a readout.

declarations.name: Spinner
declarations.description: Takes its color from the text around it.

declarations.name: Swap
declarations.description: A round toggle that swaps between two faces, like play and pause.

declarations.name: Switch
declarations.description: Turns a setting on or off right away. Works in forms.

declarations.name: Tab
declarations.description: One tab in fem-tabs.

declarations.name: TabBar
declarations.description: The bottom bar of a mobile app. A few top-level destinations, each an icon over a short label.

declarations.name: TabBarItem
declarations.description: One destination in a fem-tab-bar: an icon over a short label.

declarations.name: Table
declarations.description: A data table drawn from columns and rows. Rows alternate fills instead of drawing lines, so it stays flat. Sortable columns sort on click.

declarations.name: Tabs
declarations.description: Switches between views. The underline slides.

declarations.name: Tag
declarations.description: A small label. With removable, it gets an x that sends a remove event. The app decides what to do.

declarations.name: Text
declarations.description: Running text on the type scale. Numbers get the numeric face with the numeric flag.

declarations.name: Toast
declarations.description: A short message that appears and leaves on its own. Use showToast().

declarations.name: Tooltip
declarations.description: A short label that appears on hover or focus.
